name: Morakniv Garberg BlackBlade Carbon Steel Survival Kit
summary: A carbon-steel bushcraft reference with a sheath-mounted survival kit. Morakniv documents kit 13915; the accessories included with the selected Canadian ASIN still require confirmation before its buying link can be enabled.
description: A sheath-mounted kit can keep an edge-maintenance tool and a fire starter together with a camp knife. Morakniv’s Garberg Black Blade (C) Survival Kit reference is item 13915. Its carbon blade needs care even with a protective coating. The manufacturer kit and the Canadian retailer package are separate questions: the illustration shows accessories, but it cannot establish what B09214DLJ6 includes. Check the selected package against the manufacturer kit before purchase. No current price or availability is established.
